message.reasoning_content:
I need to implement a `cappedRunningTotal` function that computes a running total of the input array, but caps each cumulative sum at the given limit. Once the total reaches or exceeds the cap, all subsequent positions should remain at the cap value.

I drafted two implementation approaches. One uses a boolean flag to freeze the running total at the cap after the first overflow. The other simply applies `Math.min(total + num, cap)` on each iteration.

The `Math.min` approach is equivalent and cleaner. Since all elements are non-negative, once the running total reaches the cap, every subsequent sum will also be capped.
